channel.title: HSJ - Latest news
channel.description: Custom RSS feed for HSJ latest news

item.title: Exclusive: First AI clinical negligence claims lodged
item.description: The NHS has received its first clinical negligence claims related to the use of artificial intelligence, HSJ can reveal.

item.title: Chair of £3bn trust to step down
item.description: The chair of a £3bn hospital trust will step down at the end of the year, after a decade spent leading some of the NHS’s top organisations.

item.title: NHSE’s FDP claims face fresh investigation
item.description: NHS England is being investigated again by the statistics regulator after a trust revealed it did not write a case study highlighting the local benefits of the FDP.

item.title: 17 trusts lose segment 1 status under new league table rules
item.description: Ten fewer trusts are in the top segment of NHS England’s oversight framework, in the first results under revised rules that have raised the bar for the highest rating.

item.title: Mapped: RTT waiting times
item.description: An interactive map of local referral-to-treatment waiting times around England, updated with the latest data for July 2026.

item.title: Controversial hospital group to be dissolved
item.description: A troubled group board has voted to dissolve a controversial partnership between two trusts following recommendations by an external review.

item.title: Largest trust overhauls procurement practices after HSJ probe
item.description: The largest trust in the NHS has had to overhaul its procurement processes after problems with a 12-year consultancy contract were exposed by HSJ .

item.title: Fine AI firms that harm patients, demands tech commission
item.description: The medicines regulator should be allowed to fine AI companies that put patients at risk, its chief executive has said.

item.title: NHSE staff risk losing ‘thousands’ in redundancy payouts
item.description: Hundreds of NHS England staff who took partial retirement are in danger of receiving redundancy payments which are tens of thousands of pounds lower than they expected.

item.title: Ministers to unpick Healthwatch abolition
item.description: Ministers have indicated they will amend the Health Bill in the Lords to preserve an independent local voice for patients and care users.

item.title: CQC chair nearly said no to job
item.description: The government’s chosen candidate to chair the Care Quality Commission has revealed she initially turned the opportunity down, and that the regulator’s former chair had told her it was not a “great idea”.

item.title: Exclusive: ‘Landmark’ safety policy was barely tested before launch
item.description: The “Martha’s Rule for maternity services” was used just 13 times in a national pilot before being cited by government and adopted by ministers as a solution to the maternity crisis, HSJ can reveal.

item.title: Single water contract to save NHS £5m a year
item.description: NHS England is centralising the NHS’s water contracts in a move it says could save at least £5m a year.

item.title: Major trust freed after nine years of NHSE intervention
item.description: One of England’s largest hospital trusts has been freed from NHS England enforcement action that ran for almost a decade.

item.title: UK’s largest private hospital group sold in £1bn deal
item.description: One of the NHS’s largest private providers, Spire Healthcare Group, has agreed to a £1bn takeover by a group of investment firms.

item.title: Exclusive: Hundreds sacked for snooping on patient records
item.description: More than 200 NHS staff have been sacked and around 2,000 others sanctioned for inappropriately viewing patient records over the past five years, HSJ can reveal.

item.title: ICB plan says trust must cut staff by 15%
item.description: An acute trust would have to cut its workforce by almost 15 per cent and its costs by 26 per cent under a draft five-year plan set by its integrated care board.

item.title: Hot summer hit trust’s finances
item.description: An ambulance service will have to make an additional £1.6m in savings due to high demand over the hot summer and has been put under intense monitoring by NHS England.

item.title: Revealed: NHSE top team clear-out cost more than £800k
item.description: NHS England spent more than £800,000 on payouts for six directors last year as it cleared out its top team, it has been revealed.

item.title: ‘Process error’ leaves major supplier off £140m framework
item.description: A global market-leading medical device manufacturer has failed to join a key national framework worth up to £140m over four years – potentially disrupting supply and increasing costs to hospitals.
